statements.quote: The percentage of revenue derived from these product categories during the current fiscal year was approximately 65% from Core, 18% from Cognitive Adjacencies, and 17% from Networking software and services.
statements.notes: The previous sentence defines 'Core' as 'Data Center, Cloud and AI Networking', so 65% is the share for the data-center, cloud and AI category. It is not AI alone and includes cloud networking. The sentence says 'current fiscal year' without naming a year, so the filing year (2024) applies. Separately, the 48% from 'Cloud and AI Titans' in the same passage is a customer grouping, not AI revenue, so it is not recorded.

statements.quote: In addition, although the focus on deployment of AI enabled solutions has driven increased demand for networking, the long-term trajectory is unknown.
statements.notes: Names AI deployment as a driver of networking demand, which drives Arista's revenue. It gives no amount or share.

none_found.reason: The only capex statement is the $235.0–$260.0 million Santa Clara building, covering office, lab and data center space. No sentence links capital expenditures to AI. AI-related purchase commitments are described as working capital, not capex.
R&D investment is described generally (cloud networking platform, new products). No sentence quantifies or attributes operating expenses to AI.
